description: This file defines a logging provider implementation for the Orleans framework, specifically a FileLoggerProvider that outputs logs to a file. It contains a class for delivering logging functionality via files, an extension method to easily add this provider to a logging builder, and related methods.

classes.name: FileLoggerProvider
classes.description: Implements an IIS logging provider that writes logs to a file.

classes.name: FileLoggerProviderExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods to add the FileLoggerProvider to an ILoggingBuilder.

methods.name: FileLoggerProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the log output with a specified file path.

methods.name: CreateLogger
methods.description: Creates a new FileLogger instance for a given category name.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the underlying log output resource.

methods.name: AddFile
methods.description: Extension method that adds the FileLoggerProvider to a logging builder with a specified file path.
